samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
	<description>Implements a simple radix-2 divider capable of performing division on either signed or unsigned 8-bit operands. The result includes both the quotient and remainder.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst">Resets the module's state.</input>
		<input id="sign">A 1-bit signal that indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
		<input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">An 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
		<input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">An 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
		<input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit signal that indicates if a valid operation request is present.</input>
		<output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
		<output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The output which contains the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
	endports
	<parameter_description>
		<parameter name="DIVIDE_SIGN">Signed division operation.</parameter>
		<parameter name="DIVIDE_UNSIGNED">Unsigned division operation.</parameter>
	</parameter_description>
	<logic_description>
		<reg id="signed_op" type="sequential_logic">Indicates if the operation is signed.</reg>
		<reg id="dividend_save" type="sequential_logic" width_description="[7:0]">Saved dividend for division operation.</reg>
		<reg id="divisor_save" type="sequential_logic" width_description="[7:0]">Saved divisor for division operation.</reg>
		<reg id="neg_divisor" type="sequential_logic" width_description="[9:0]">Negative divisor for subtraction during division operation.</reg>
		<reg id="sr_carry_out" type="sequential_logic">Carry-out from the subtractor.</reg>
		<reg id="start_cnt" type="sequential_logic">Start flag for division operation.</reg>
		<reg id="cnt" type="sequential_logic" width_description="[3:0]">Count value for division operation.</reg>
		<reg id="res_valid_reg" type="sequential_logic">Register indicating the validity of the result.</reg>
		<wire id="sub_res" width_description="[9:0]">Subtraction result from the subtractor.</wire>
		<wire id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]">Multiplexer output for selecting between subtraction result and shifted right operand.</wire>
		<wire id="sr_right_in" width_description="[9:0]">Shift register input from the mux.</wire>
		<wire id="dividend_left_in" width_description="[9:0]">Left input to the shift register.</wire>
		<wire id="neg_divisor_left_in" width_description="[9:0]">Left input to the shift register for negative divisor.</wire>
		<wire id="dividend_sign" width_description="[9:0]">Sign extension for positive dividend.</wire>
		<wire id="divisor_sign" width_description="[9:0]">Sign extension for positive divisor.</wire>
		<wire id="shift_sel" width_description="[9:0]">Selector for shift register input.</wire>
		<wire id="neg_shift_sel" width_description="[9:0]">Selector for negative shift register input.</wire>
		<wire id="add_sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Addition/subtraction result for the shift register.</wire>
		<wire id="shift_add_sub_sel" width_description="[9:0]">Selector for adding or subtracting in the shift register.</wire>
		<wire id="shift_add_sub_out" width_description="[9:0]">Output after adding or subtracting in the shift register.</wire>
		<wire id="final_remainder" width_description="[9:0]">Final remainder result.</wire>
		<wire id="final_quotient" width_description="[9:0]">Final quotient result.</wire>
		<wire id="final_result" width_description="[15:0]">Final result combining remainder and quotient.</wire>
		<wire id="rem_neg_sel" width_description="[15:0]">Selector for negative remainder selection.</wire>
		<wire id="quo_neg_sel" width_description="[15:0]">Selector for negative quotient selection.</wire>
		<wire id="remainder" width_description="[15:0]">Remainder part of the result.</wire>
		<wire id="quotient" width_description="[15:0]">Quotient part of the result.</wire>
		<wire id="final_res_valid" width_description="[15:0]">Final result validity.</wire>
		<wire id="res_consumed" width_description="[15:0]">Indicator if the result has been consumed.</wire>
	</logic_description>
	
	<implementation>
		SYNTHESIS OFF
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				signed_op <= 1'b0;
			end else if((opn_valid == 1'b1)&&(res_valid_reg == 1'b0))begin
				signed_op <= sign;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				dividend_save <= 8'd0;
			end else if((opn_valid == 1'b1)&&(res_valid_reg == 1'b0))begin
				dividend_save <= dividend;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				divisor_save <= 8'd0;
			end else if((opn_valid == 1'b1)&&(res_valid_reg == 1'b0))begin
				divisor_save <= divisor;
			end
		end
	
		assign dividend_left_in = {signed_op ? dividend_save[7] : 1'b0 , dividend_save};
		
		assign divisor_sign = {8'd0 , ((signed_op && divisor[7]) ? ~divisor + 1'b1 : divisor)};
		assign neg_divisor = ~(divisor_sign << 1);
		assign neg_divisor_left_in = {neg_divisor[8] , neg_divisor};
		
		assign dividend_sign = {8'd0 , ((signed_op && dividend[7]) ? ~dividend + 1'b1 : dividend)};
		assign shift_sel = {dividend_sign[9], dividend_sign} << cnt;
		assign neg_shift_sel = {neg_divisor_left_in[9], neg_divisor_left_in} << cnt;
		
		assign add_sub_result = sr_carry_out ? shift_sel : neg_shift_sel;
		assign shift_add_sub_sel = sr_carry_out ? 10'd1 : 10'd0;
		assign shift_add_sub_out = add_sub_result + shift_add_sub_sel;
		
		reg [9:0] sr_temp;
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				sr_temp <= 10'd0;
			end else if(start_cnt == 1'b1)begin
				sr_temp <= shift_add_sub_out;
			end else begin
				sr_temp <= sr_temp >> 1;
			end
		end
			
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				cnt <= 4'd0;
			end else if(opn_valid == 1'b1)begin
				cnt <= 4'd1;
			end else if((cnt != 4'd0)&&(!res_valid_reg))begin
				cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
			end else begin
				cnt <= 4'd0;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b0;
			end else if((cnt != 4'd0)&&(!res_valid_reg))begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b1;
			end else begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b0;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				sr_carry_out <= 1'b0;
			end else if(cnt == 4'd8)begin
				sr_carry_out <= sr_temp[9];
			end else if((cnt != 4'd0)&&(!res_valid_reg))begin
				sr_carry_out <= sr_temp[9];
			end else begin
				sr_carry_out <= 1'b0;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
				res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
			end else if((cnt == 4'd8)||((cnt != 4'd0)&&(!res_valid_reg)))begin
				res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
			end else begin
				res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst == 1'b1)begin
			end else if((cnt == 4'd8)||(cnt == 4'd0))begin
				//SR <= (signed_op & (dividend[7]^divisor[7])) ? (~final_result + 1'b1) : final_result;
			end
		end
		
		
		assign final_remainder = signed_op ? dividend_sign - (divisor_save * ((dividend[7]^divisor[7])? 1 : 0)) : dividend_sign;
		assign final_quotient = (signed_op & (dividend[7]^divisor[7])) ? ((~final_result + 1'b1)>>1) : final_result>>1;
		assign rem_neg_sel = {16{!final_remainder[9]}};
		assign quo_neg_sel = {16{(final_remainder[9]&final_quotient[9])}};
		assign remainder = ({16{rem_neg_sel}} | {final_remainder , 8'h0});
		assign quotient = ({16{quo_neg_sel}} | final_quotient);
		assign final_result = {remainder , quotient}; 
		
		assign final_res_valid = (cnt == 4'd8) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
		assign res_consumed = res_valid ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
		assign res_valid = (final_res_valid && !res_consumed) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
		assign result = (final_res_valid && !res_consumed) ? final_result : 16'd0;
		SYNTHESIS ON
	end
</module>
